16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3324|031480cd.name: Grol'dar
3324|031480cd.text: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $N.

3387|da8a5dad.name: Jorn Skyseer
3387|da8a5dad.text: Although we call this land the Barrens, to one who knows where to look this place teems with life.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

3934|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

5815|721fd095.name: Kurgul
5815|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

5909|08ad8d7f.name: Cazul
5909|08ad8d7f.text: Few have the ambition to seek true power. Fewer still have the resolve to do what is necessary to claim it. Power belongs to those who are willing to pay its price, $c.

6791|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Wiley
6791|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

7166|912c996a.name: Wrenix's Gizmotronic Apparatus
7166|912c996a.text: The machine comes alive at your touch.

1130-accept.name: Jorn Skyseer
1130-accept.text:
$N, Melor Stonehoof has heard of your deeds, and has set a path before you.

If you wish to take it, then go to Thunder Bluff and speak with Melor.  You will find him on Hunter's Rise.
1130-accept.title: Melor Sends Word

1507-accept.name: Gan'rul Bloodeye
1507-accept.text:
The time has come for you to learn more of the summoning magics. You will learn to summon a sayaad, a creature of incredible mental powers. It can lull those of weak minds into its servitude--but have no fear! I feel certain that you will be equal to the challenge.

A sayaad can only be summoned when baited with an item that represents great devotion and love. I leave it to you to find such an object.

A suggestion? Speak with Cazul... There seems to be little the ancient $c does not know.
1507-accept.title: Devourer of Souls

1507-complete.name: Cazul
1507-complete.text:
Hm... $N. You are still new to your path, but I sense the possibility for greatness in you.

You were born with gifts, $N. See that they do not go to waste.
1507-complete.title: Devourer of Souls

1508-accept.name: Cazul
1508-accept.text:
If Gan'rul has sent you to me, it must be that you are to summon a succubus, a female of the sayaad race, and need an object to use for enticement.

Hmm... If you trust a blind man to lead you, $N, then listen. In the bluffs of Orgrimmar, west of the wind rider tower, lives Zankaja. She waits for the return of her mate.

Go to her.
1508-accept.title: Blind Cazul

1508-complete.name: Zankaja
1508-complete.text: Have you come with news of Dogran? He was to have returned days ago, and I have heard nothing...
1508-complete.title: Blind Cazul

1509-accept.name: Zankaja
1509-accept.text:
My mate, Dogran, was recently sent to the Crossroads for duty. It was a promotion, and he was very proud.

I was sad, of course, but I didn't let him know that. And worried, too. The Barrens is a more dangerous place than Orgrimmar, and I feared the worst.

Now it's been a week after he should have returned, and I have received no word from him...

Perhaps you could go to the Crossroads and see if they have any news? He worked with Gazrog, who should still be stationed there.
1509-accept.title: News of Dogran

1509-complete.name: Gazrog
1509-complete.text:
Zankaja? That's Dogran's mate, right?

Yeah, I've heard from him, but it's not the sort of news we should let get back to her...

No, he's not dead. But he is injured and a prisoner of the quilboar.
1509-complete.title: News of Dogran

1510-accept.name: Gazrog
1510-accept.text:
He was stationed at Camp Taurajo, where we've been trying to weed out the quilboar. He led a few grunts to one of their camps, where he was hurt bad. The others made it back and tried to rescue him. He was in bad shape, his wounds festered, so they were afraid to move him without patching him up first.

They sent a message here, requesting a healing draught from the trolls at the Malaka'jin at the base of the Stonetalon Mountains. We sent someone to get it, but they haven't returned yet.
1510-accept.title: News of Dogran

6382-accept.name: Jorn Skyseer
6382-accept.text:
Your strength impresses me, $c.  Your willingness to embrace the hunt gives me confidence that you could move on to bigger game... and bigger challenges.

The forests of Ashenvale represent a vast untamed wild that the Horde seeks to impose its own will upon, both politically and spiritually.  If you seek to prove yourself in an unproven land, seek the guidance of Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post.  The outpost is due north of the path leading from the Barrens.
6382-accept.title: The Ashenvale Hunt

882-complete.name: Jorn Skyseer
882-complete.text:
This fang is merely a token, but what it represents is profound.

Ishamuhale's strength is in you, $N.  May you use it with temperance.  That is your burden.

That is your honor.
882-complete.title: Ishamuhale

888-complete.name: Gazlowe
888-complete.text: It's a relief to get all this stuff back, so thanks for your help, $N. You know, I could use a $r like you to help out with my operation here. If you're ever looking for work, don't forget about how well Gazlowe pays for service!
888-complete.title: Stolen Booty

891-complete.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
891-complete.text:
Alas, the righteous Alliance guns have been silenced. You shall be rewarded for your aid, $N.

Now to tend to the grim task of recovering the bodies of the dead....
891-complete.title: The Guns of Northwatch

891-progress.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
891-progress.text: My fleet is in peril with Captain Fairmount and her damned cannoneers blasting away from Northwatch Hold. I want her soldiers to pay as well. Fill my hand with medals from their dead and I will know that vengeance has been given to my fallen privateers.
891-progress.title: The Guns of Northwatch

898-accept.name: Gilthares Firebough
898-accept.text:
Finally! Someone to rescue me!

I can't believe you got past the guards. These zealots from Theramore are out of their minds. They sank our ship and imprisoned me, the only survivor. I was called an enemy and threat to the Alliance.

Me! A threat to their great sham of an Alliance? I was a deckhand on a moonshine transport between Ratchet and Booty Bay.

Enough talk. Help me get back to Ratchet will you? Let me know when you're ready and we'll make our break.
898-accept.title: Free From the Hold

898-complete.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
898-complete.text:
And to think, we thought Firebough was long dead!

Your heroics have earned you a place of honor with the Thalo'dan Privateers, $N.
898-complete.title: Free From the Hold

907-accept.name: Jorn Skyseer
907-accept.text:
Now, $N, you must face the great thunder lizards.  So large are the beasts, the ground rumbles as they stomp across the plains.  Take care as you fight them, for one false step and you may find yourself beneath their feet.

You will find the thunder lizards in the southern Barrens.  They are known as Stormsnouts, Stormhides and Thunderheads.  Return to me after you have bested them.
907-accept.title: Enraged Thunder Lizards

97253-progress.name: Wrenix the Wretched
97253-progress.text: Not another word out of you until your pockets are jingling with metal!
97253-progress.title: Parts and Pieces
